findings.name: Complete, token-driven theming

adjustments: -1: a one-frame flash, no content or state lost

evidence.detail: First sampled paint: bg rgb(247,246,242) with data-theme unset; the next sample is rgb(21,23,20). The stored theme is applied in a useEffect after the async IndexedDB read, and index.html has no pre-paint script.
All surfaces have light + dark token blocks; system preference respected via prefers-color-scheme; color-scheme declared. 3× #fff literals are the only unthemed colours (see A11Y-03).

Pre-paint inline script reads the localStorage theme mirror and App seeds its initial state from it, so the first render no longer resets the attribute to system. Verified: stored dark → dataset.theme="dark" and dark background at DOMContentLoaded and after settling; choosing system removes the mirror.
evidence.tool: Playwright + axe-core re-run on the merged build

findings.acceptance_criteria: No unthemed islands; no flash

fix.summary: Inline a tiny pre-paint script in index.html that reads the stored theme from localStorage (mirrored on setPref) and sets data-theme before first paint.
